label: FR, pub premium moderne
design: A French man in his early forties with a rich, grounded baritone, the voice of a premium sports brand advertisement: confident, punchy, modern and natural, with a hint of grit. Native Parisian French. Recorded close to a high-end studio microphone, natural breathing, real human texture and small imperfections, never robotic, never synthetic.
acting: Deliver it like the voice-over of a viral motivational video: natural, human and conversational, never theatrical, never announcer-like. Speak with real conviction and energy, a lively, dynamic rhythm with short punchy pauses, stress the key words, and let the intensity build up to a powerful, inspiring last line. Sounds like a real person talking from the heart, never shouting.
text: Les marchés ne dorment jamais. Tokyo ouvre. Londres prend le relais. New York fait trembler le monde. Chaque jour, des milliers de chiffres. Les autres terminaux vous les donnent tous. Macro Arsenal vous dit lesquels comptent. En direct. Chaque matin, notre lecture des marchés. Chaque soir, le verdict, publié. Même quand on a tort. Et avant chaque trade, Doji vérifie tout. Votre plan. Les niveaux. Le calendrier. Votre risque. La puissance d'un terminal de pro. Sans le prix d'un terminal de pro. Macro Arsenal. Le terminal qui change votre vision du trading.
